methodology: The decomposition process involved analyzing both the original research topic and the generated technical specification to extract independent and self-contained atomic units. mindtraced_atomic_units: The counter must count from 1 to 10, inclusive.
The reset input is active high and synchronous.
The counter resets to 1 on the next clock edge when reset is asserted.
The module is defined as 'module top_module(input clk, input reset, output reg [3:0] q);'.
spec_atomic_units: The module 'top_module' has three ports: 'clk', 'reset', and 'q'.
The 'clk' input triggers counting on its rising edge.
The 'reset' input sets 'q' to 4'b0001 (1) on the next rising edge when asserted high.
The output 'q' increments by 1 on each clock pulse until it reaches 4'b1010 (10).
When 'q' reaches 10, it wraps around to 4'b0001 (1) on the next clock pulse.
The reset operation is synchronous, occurring on the next rising edge of 'clk'.
The design uses non-blocking assignments to update 'q' for proper sequential behavior.
The counting logic is implemented within an 'always @(posedge clk)' block.
